fix: (1) Skip a no-patch commit with a recorded reason, or classify it as a non-transient refusal. (2) WaveDir refuses an id outside ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ and returns an error. (3) Keep a commit-to-record index in the wave dir, written by WriteRecord, and prune records at the wave boundary (I10). (4) Bound the identity search by PreCycleHEAD as well. (5) Move the patch-id call into one helper (integration.Repo.PatchID) and make the other two call it.

summary: Five I0 gaps are safe at shadow but not at enforce. (1) buildDeliverable runs PatchID on each commit of base..commit; a merge commit or an empty commit has no patch, so an enforce ship fails as transient and every retry fails the same way. (2) integration.WaveDir does not validate the wave id; a ../ in the id leaves .evolve/waves once I2 supplies real wave ids. (3) FindRecord and FindRecordByCommit read every record of every wave on each miss; no index or retention exists. (4) core.landedByRecord searches base_sha..HEAD with no PreCycleHEAD bound, unlike the ancestry rule (onHead && !beforeCycle). (5) git patch-id --stable is wrapped three times (core/composition_carryforward.go computePatchID, adapters/ledger/composition.go PatchID, integration.Repo.PatchID).
